name: Vampire Dog
source:
Humans and vampires are at odds, and the era of conflict is reaching its climax.
On a mission to hunt the vampires' leader, the "Primogenitor", a young knight named Fabrice loses consciousness in the midst of retreating from a losing battle. Fabrice wakes to find his enemy, the vampiric Primogenitor herself, waiting for him.

"So many of my people have been killed, and I've got so much free time. It's so boring...so you're going to be our plaything."

What fate awaits Fabrice, the man who'd been kidnapped and imprisoned by his enemy and made into her pet......?!

This is the story of a young man whose whole life had been ruined by a vampire woman.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/11526]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
人类与吸血鬼矛盾重重，冲突的时代即将达到高潮。
一位名叫法布里斯的年轻骑士在执行追捕吸血鬼首领“始祖”的任务时，在一场失败的战斗中撤退时失去了知觉。法布里斯醒来发现他的敌人，吸血鬼始祖本人正在等待着他。

“我的很多人都被杀了，而我却有那么多空闲时间。这太无聊了……所以你将成为我们的玩物。”

被敌人绑架并囚禁并成为她宠物的法布里斯的命运将会如何……？！

这是一个年轻人的故事，他的一生被吸血鬼女人毁了。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/11526]NovelGame[/url]]
